dogecoin.text: @elonmusk I hope on May 8th on SNL Elon Musk asks his followers to all purchase10 or more shares of Dogecoin for the remainder of the show.  In return, Dogecoin skyrockets past $1 and hopefully $2.  He'll have the attention of his largest audience and more thus far.
